title: Jazzy American Rice Bowl
description: A simple and flavorful rice bowl dish with a jazzy twist.
instructions: Heat 2 cups of water to a boil in a medium saucepan.
Add 1 cup of American rice to the saucepan and cook according to package instructions.
While the rice cooks, heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
Add 1 cup of jazzed up vegetables (such as bell peppers and onions) to the skillet and cook until tender.
Once the rice is cooked, fluff it with a fork and stir in 1 cup of jazzed up vegetables.
Transfer the rice mixture to a bowl and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or cilantro, if desired.
